text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Such magnificent use of your trainee's
innate
talents... I'm impressed by
something different
every time I come
for an interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You're exactly the trainer I believed you
to be! A
reporter could ask for nothing
more!
